report_name: FDD Urges NIST, NSA to Evaluate New Anti-Ransomware Tech

identities.name: Foundation for Defense of Democracies
identities.description: A Washington D.C.-based think tank that publicly called on NIST and the NSA to evaluate vaultless, keyless pseudonymization as a defense against ransomware and data breaches.

identities.name: National Institute of Standards and Technology
identities.description: A U.S. government standards body urged by the FDD to formally evaluate vaultless, keyless pseudonymization technology.

identities.name: National Security Agency
identities.description: A U.S. government agency urged by the FDD to formally evaluate vaultless, keyless pseudonymization technology.
